# data.docker_compose_port

<!-- Code generated by tools/genskill from the provider schema. DO NOT EDIT. -->

Kind: data-source. Back to [SKILL.md](../SKILL.md).

Finds the public port of a service's port binding, like `docker compose port <service> <port>`, from the container's `NetworkSettings.Ports`.

## Arguments and attributes

| Name | Type | Status | Forces replacement | Sensitive | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `bindings` | `list(object)` | computed |  |  | Every host binding of the requested service port (NetworkSettings.Ports["<port>/<proto>"]). |
| `container_id` | `string` | computed |  |  | The container that was inspected. |
| `docker_server_version` | `string` | computed |  |  | Docker Engine version of the daemon. |
| `engine_api_version` | `string` | computed |  |  | Engine API version negotiated with the daemon. |
| `host_ip` | `string` | computed |  |  | The host IP of the first binding (empty: all interfaces). |
| `index` | `number` | optional |  |  | The container number when the service has several (CLI `--index`). Default `1`. |
| `name` | `string` | required |  |  | The compose project name (`com.docker.compose.project` label, CLI `--project-name`). |
| `private_port` | `number` | required |  |  | The container port. |
| `protocol` | `string` | optional |  |  | The port protocol: `tcp` (default), `udp` or `sctp`. |
| `published_port` | `number` | computed |  |  | The host port of the first binding; null when the port is not published. |
| `service` | `string` | required |  |  | The service name. |
